svg.title: Same log, same answer: shape beats tuning by 4.9x
svg.desc: One 1 GB access log feeding two pipelines. The upper five-stage pipeline sorts 8.9 million records before aggregating and takes 135.4 seconds; the lower two-stage pipeline builds a histogram in a single awk pass and takes 27.7 seconds. Beside them, two bars show LC_ALL=C sorting in 20.4 seconds against 86.2 seconds in the default locale, a small branching tree shows catastrophic regex backtracking growing from 37 ms to 31.3 seconds, and a chain of five piped greps is crossed out in red.
svg.text: Same log, same answer: shape beats tuning by 4.9x
one file, one answer, two shapes
sort must hold all 8.9M records, then n
one pass, 12 counters, no global sort =
each extra character DOUBLES the work
careful - nothing here was tuned. No flag
would have bought you 4.9x. It is a different
each pipe is a fork. Count your stages.
